query:
Which member made the argument about structured effort over elevation, stating that the Ridge loop 'turns into a sufferfest', while another member later expressed dissatisfaction with the same shorter route alternative, calling it essentially not worth doing?

Options:
A. Tomás
B. Marcus
C. Derek
D. Lena
context:
[1] (about=Ben, episodic, t0 @2026-01-10T08:42:00) haha I'm in either way, not picky. Ridge sounds fun if we go slow on the climb 👍
[2] (about=Callum, core, t0 @2026-01-10T08:15:00) Prefers Ridge loop because Valley flat has zero measurable power data worth tracking.
[3] (about=Derek, core, t0 @2026-01-10T08:15:00) Prefers structured, sensible rides over chasing elevation; thinks Ridge loop turns into a sufferfest with strung-out riders.
[4] (about=Lena, core, t15 @2026-03-07T13:10:00) Rode Cranfield ridge 10% gradient today after avoiding anything above 8% for over a year due to hip flexor; it was fine.
[5] (about=Lena, core, t16 @2026-03-07T13:12:00) Completed Cranfield ridge 10-12% climb without pain after six months of self-directed rehab.
[6] (about=Marcus, episodic, t0 @2026-01-10T08:15:00) Right, first ride of the year. Tomás and I have two options ready. Option A: Cranfield Ridge loop, 82km, 650m elevation. Option B: River Valley flat, 55km. Vote by 9pm Friday.
[7] (about=Priya, core, t0 @2026-01-10T08:15:00) Prefers challenging routes like Ridge loop for first ride of the year; thinks Valley flat is not a proper first-ride vibe.
[8] (about=Saoirse, core, t2 @2026-01-17T11:47:00) Wants to do Cranfield Ridge loop again in summer when it is dry.
[9] (about=Saoirse, core, t16 @2026-03-07T13:12:00) Will take the ridge route next Saturday.
[10] (about=GROUP, said_by=Tomás, group-interaction, t0 @2026-01-10T08:15:00) Route chosen: Cranfield Ridge loop (82km, 650m elevation). Vote tally: Ridge (Priya, Saoirse, Callum, Marcus), Valley (Derek, Yuki), flexible (Lena, Ben).
[11] (about=GROUP, said_by=Tomás, group-interaction, t5 @2026-01-31T09:05:00) Ride cancelled due to 35mph north wind, gusting higher on ridge. Next ride next Saturday.
agent_answer: C. Derek — he prefers structured, sensible rides over chasing elevation and said the Ridge loop “turns into a sufferfest.” The other member dissatisfied with the Valley flat alternative is not among the options (Priya and Callum expressed such views in the memory).

query:

A different member in the same session said they valued that flat section precisely for its measurable output. Which member made the objection to the group assumption — the one who said they had never enjoyed flat circuits?

Options:
A. Callum
B. Marcus
C. Saoirse
D. Derek
